description: List threads sorted by last activity (newest first), for self-discovery before deciding which to engage. With a user API key, pass `graphId` to list threads you can see in that space (resolve it via naumu_list_graphs). Pass `nodeId` alongside `graphId` to list only the conversations tied to that node (attached, or that created/modified it). With a bot identity key, omit `graphId` to list threads in your own graph — each row carries an `isParticipant` flag (TRUE means you were explicitly invited and your replies fan out via webhook). Page back with `cursor` set to the oldest `lastActivityAt` from the previous page.

cursor.description: Unix timestamp ms — returns threads with `lastActivityAt` strictly older than this. Omit for the newest page.

graphId.description: Graph (space) ID. Required for user API keys; omit for bot identity keys (defaults to your own graph).

nodeId.description: Scope the listing to conversations tied to this node. Requires `graphId`.

name: naumu_list_threads
title: List Threads
